title: Level B1 Intensive French
description: Development of intermediate language skills and intercultural competencies to facilitate communication and interaction in everyday and diverse contexts (school, leisure), through oral and written practice. Exploration of differences and cultural diversities in French-speaking regions and countries. Advances to a B1 level of the European Common Framework for Languages. Prepares for upper-intermediate (B2) study upon completion.
notes: Credit will be granted for only one of FRAN 170, FRAN 171, FRAN 172.
